summary: BrasilAgro, a Brazilian agricultural real estate company, submitted a Form 6-K to the SEC on September 4, 2026, reporting a material fact: initial estimates for its 2026/2027 harvest year. The report details planned planted areas, production tonnage, and sugarcane harvesting volumes, including crop mix changes due to commodity prices and El Niño weather risks. This is a routine operational update for a foreign private issuer, not an event triggering a special-situation category. There are no M&A, capital, or governance actions involved, making this filing unsuitable for special-situations classification.
